## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that addresses it.

## Validation

- [ ] swift test
- [ ] swift build -c release
- [ ] git diff --check
- [ ] User-visible behavior was tested on macOS 15 or later

## Safety and privacy

- [ ] The change preserves PortHarbor's local-first privacy model
- [ ] Process-control changes fail closed and include safety tests
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, private paths, or generated build products are included

## Documentation

- [ ] Documentation and changelog entries were updated when needed

## Screenshots

Include before and after images for user-interface changes.
